description: Download a recording's MP4 to a local file so YOU can process it — clip a segment, extract frames, transcode, etc. with your own tools (e.g. ffmpeg). Clipy does NOT clip/extract server-side; you operate on the downloaded file. Returns the local path.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to save the .mp4 to. Defaults to the OS temp dir.

name: download_recording
